reason: In the Linked accounts dialog the bank-icon link beside Exclude all accounts (to /accounts#external-accounts) has no text, aria-label or title, its SVG is aria-hidden and it has no aria-describedby, so it announces as link with no name and fails 4.1.2 and 2.4.4. Hovering shows a Go to Accounts tooltip, but Tab onto the link shows none, so keyboard and screen-reader users get no hint of where it goes; the task is hard, not blocked.
